_note: Config for emit_summit_matrix.py / emit_evolution.py - the SUMMIT side of estMatrix and the `evolution` block for NVDA (SAB's model, US$ millions, NVIDIA fiscal years). Written Nov 2 2026. Labels: js/summit-map/nvda.js. Dumps: scripts/consensus/dumps/nvda_summit/ (get_fundamentals, projection_history, pulled 2026-11-02).
_vintages_note: lastActual from the data: 2025-12-12 stands after 3Q FY26 (its FY2026 = reported 1Q-3Q + its 4Q); 2026-03-04 after 4Q FY26 (FY2026 = 215,938, the release); 2026-08-28 after 2Q FY27 (FY2027 = reported 1Q-2Q + its 3Q + 4Q).
_horizon_note: Quarters past the model's current fiscal year are placeholders (2025-12-12: 1Q27 onward are not quarters - 1Q27 124,643, 4Q27 195,323 do not tie to anything; 2026-03-04 and 2026-08-28: 1Q28 repeats 1Q27). Kept: 2025-12-12 -> 4Q26 only; 2026-03-04 -> 1Q27-4Q27; 2026-08-28 -> 3Q27-4Q27.
_basis_note: BASIS: in the 2025-12-12 file the model's adjusted lines (OP_INCOME, ADJ_GROSS_PROFIT, EBITDA, EARNINGS) exclude SBC (NVIDIA's old non-GAAP); from 2026-03-04 they do not (NVIDIA's current definition). The 2025-12-12 cells of opinc_ng / gp / mebitda are removed after generation (post-filter in the build) so the two bases never share a line.

evolution._cons_map_note: Lines the model stores no consensus for: mapped off the Bloomberg workbook (each model date takes the Street's latest file on or before it; up to ~3 months stale). gp / opinc_ng consensus exists only from 2026-03-02 (NVIDIA's definition change), so the Dec 2025 column is empty. No consensus for model EBITDA (Bloomberg's comparable EBITDA is another definition) or GAAP op. income.
